beats.summary: Andy instructs Erin to fake an important phone call to impress a client, but the prank escalates with a fake death call from Darryl.

evidence.snippet: Andy: In two minutes I want you to come into this meeting and tell me I have a really important phone call.
Darryl (on phone): It's Darryl. Erin told me to pretend to be a cop and say your mom died.

beats.summary: Pam reveals she is pregnant and training a temp named Cathy to replace her during maternity leave.

evidence.snippet: Pam: I'm training a temp to be my replacement while I'm on maternity leave. Oh I should've mentioned I'm pregnant.

beats.summary: Jim and Ryan discuss the new temp's relationship status, with Jim doubting she is single.
Andy and Darryl plan to play music together during lunch, with Kevin joining on drums.

evidence.snippet: [STAGE] Kevin playing drums with chicken legs

beats.summary: Office staff discuss the attractiveness of the new temp and Pam, with Dwight objecting to praising a pregnant woman and Helen Mirren.
